WHO I AM

Not an Agency.
Just Shoaib.

I entered Web3 with zero experience and zero connections. I tried building an L1 blockchain, failed. Spent six months silently building a Layer 2 called Pak Chain, tested it with 57 people before a GPU failure ended it. I never quit. I just kept building.

Today I vibe-code full Web3 products using AI tools, run ambassador programs, create content, and architect communities. No playbook, no agency, no shortcuts.

Every project on this page was built by one person. One set of hands. One relentless work ethic.

"Work silently, ship loudly."

STARTED

Web3 journey from absolute zero, no team, no connections, no shortcuts.

BUILT

Pak Chain L2 solo from scratch. Tested with 57 real users before GPU failure.

METHOD

Vibe coding with AI-assisted workflows. Ship fast, iterate faster.

RULE

Work silently. Announce when done. No noise before the product is real.

Before Web3, buildings. I also have 5 years of AutoCAD experience drawing 2D and 3D building elevations for houses and commercial buildings. Building things carefully, layer by layer, is not new to me. Only the tools changed.
